description: Show one past-paper question as a practice card the student can answer, with its figures and answer surface. The model gets the full question so it can give hints without giving the answer away. Use mark_answer to mark the student's answer.

paper_id.description: exam.now paper id from find_past_paper, e.g. 0580_s24_42 (syllabus code, series letter s/w/m and two-digit year, component).

part.description: Part id as the paper numbers it, e.g. "3", "3(a)" or "3(a)(i)".

name: practise_question
title: Practise a question
